mapper.insert: INSERT INTO identity_collision (workspace_id, person_identity_id, rebuilt_at) SELECT collision.workspace_id, collision.identity_id, #{rebuiltAt} FROM ( SELECT pi.workspace_id, pi.id AS identity_id, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY pi.workspace_id, pi.kind, pi.normalized_value ) AS collision_size FROM person_identity pi JOIN person p ON p.workspace_id = pi.workspace_id AND p.id = pi.person_id WHERE pi.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND pi.superseded_at IS NULL AND p.suspended_at IS NULL AND p.provision_ceased_at IS NULL ) collision WHERE collision.collision_size >= 2 ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rebuilt_at = #{rebuiltAt}

INSERT INTO identity_collision (workspace_id, company_identity_id, rebuilt_at) SELECT collision.workspace_id, collision.identity_id, #{rebuiltAt} FROM ( SELECT ci.workspace_id, ci.id AS identity_id, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY ci.workspace_id, ci.kind, ci.normalized_value ) AS collision_size FROM company_identity ci JOIN company c ON c.workspace_id = ci.workspace_id AND c.id = ci.company_id WHERE ci.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND ci.superseded_at IS NULL ) collision WHERE collision.collision_size >= 2 ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rebuilt_at = #{rebuiltAt}
mapper.delete: DELETE identity_collision FROM identity_collision JOIN person_identity ON person_identity.workspace_id = identity_collision.workspace_id AND person_identity.id = identity_collision.person_identity_id WHERE identity_collision.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND person_identity.person_id = #{personId}

DELETE identity_collision FROM identity_collision JOIN company_identity ON company_identity.workspace_id = identity_collision.workspace_id AND company_identity.id = identity_collision.company_identity_id WHERE identity_collision.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND company_identity.company_id = #{companyId}

DELETE FROM identity_collision WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND person_identity_id = ( SELECT singleton_identity.id FROM person_identity singleton_identity JOIN person singleton_record ON singleton_record.workspace_id = singleton_identity.workspace_id AND singleton_record.id = singleton_identity.person_id AND singleton_record.archived_at IS NULL AND singleton_record.suspended_at IS NULL AND singleton_record.provision_ceased_at IS NULL WHERE singleton_identity.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND singleton_identity.kind = #{kind} AND singleton_identity.normalized_value = #{normalizedValue} AND singleton_identity.superseded_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM person_identity other_identity JOIN person other_record ON other_record.workspace_id = other_identity.workspace_id AND other_record.id = other_identity.person_id AND other_record.archived_at IS NULL AND other_record.suspended_at IS NULL AND other_record.provision_ceased_at IS NULL WHERE other_identity.workspace_id = singleton_identity.workspace_id AND other_identity.kind = singleton_identity.kind AND other_identity.normalized_value = singleton_identity.normalized_value AND other_identity.superseded_at IS NULL AND other_identity.person_id <> singleton_identity.person_id LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY singleton_identity.person_id, singleton_identity.id LIMIT 1 )

DELETE FROM identity_collision WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND company_identity_id = ( SELECT singleton_identity.id FROM company_identity singleton_identity JOIN company singleton_record ON singleton_record.workspace_id = singleton_identity.workspace_id AND singleton_record.id = singleton_identity.company_id AND singleton_record.archived_at IS NULL WHERE singleton_identity.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND singleton_identity.kind = #{kind} AND singleton_identity.normalized_value = #{normalizedValue} AND singleton_identity.superseded_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM company_identity other_identity JOIN company other_record ON other_record.workspace_id = other_identity.workspace_id AND other_record.id = other_identity.company_id AND other_record.archived_at IS NULL WHERE other_identity.workspace_id = singleton_identity.workspace_id AND other_identity.kind = singleton_identity.kind AND other_identity.normalized_value = singleton_identity.normalized_value AND other_identity.superseded_at IS NULL AND other_identity.company_id <> singleton_identity.company_id LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY singleton_identity.company_id, singleton_identity.id LIMIT 1 )
mapper.select:
SELECT record_type, kind, normalized_value FROM ( SELECT 'person' AS record_type, pi.kind, pi.normalized_value FROM person_identity pi JOIN identity_collision ic ON ic.workspace_id = pi.workspace_id AND ic.person_identity_id = pi.id JOIN person p ON p.workspace_id = pi.workspace_id AND p.id = pi.person_id WHERE pi.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND pi.superseded_at IS NULL
GROUP BY pi.kind, pi.normalized_value HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 UNION ALL SELECT 'company' AS record_type, ci.kind, ci.normalized_value FROM company_identity ci JOIN identity_collision ic ON ic.workspace_id = ci.workspace_id AND ic.company_identity_id = ci.id JOIN company c ON c.workspace_id = ci.workspace_id AND c.id = ci.company_id WHERE ci.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND ci.superseded_at IS NULL AND c.archived_at IS NULL GROUP BY ci.kind, ci.normalized_value HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ) collision_group
WHERE record_type > #{afterRecordType} OR (record_type = #{afterRecordType} AND kind > #{afterKind}) OR (record_type = #{afterRecordType} AND kind = #{afterKind} AND normalized_value > #{afterNormalizedValue})
ORDER BY record_type, kind, normalized_value LIMIT #{limit}
